title: PQC: Post-Quantum Collaboration?
description: This talk will cover some of the basics of post-quantum cryptography, how to apply it to multiplayer collaboration files & apps, and most importantly how to deliver it to people in a accessible way. We will showcase easy-to-use "Post Quantum Collaborative" apps, as well as modules that anyone can use to make their apps sovereign, secure and privacy-enhancing in a post-quantum world. Post quantum collaboration is a made-up concept that we'll be unveiling in a light way at Devcon Mumbai with peers, anons, and friends :))
abstract: End-to-end encryption (e2ee) gave us a way to gain privacy and security in online collaboration even while most of us were dependent on centralized third parties for these activities. While e2ee remains far from ubiquitous, the privacy & security frontier has yet again moved due to quantum computers, and it carries with it the same issues that e2ee had: complexity.
